#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Use the utility/community workspace with original local source selections."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

if __package__ in (None, ""):
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
    __package__ = "model"

from .common import read_json
from .workspace import Workspace
from . import communities


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True, type=Path)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    commands.add_parser("overview")
    for name in ("table-import", "plan-save", "report-build"):
        commands.add_parser(name).add_argument("selection", type=Path)
    for name in ("table", "plan", "report"):
        commands.add_parser(name).add_argument("id")
    revise = commands.add_parser(
        "plan-revise-csv", help="Receive an edited interventions.csv as the next saved plan revision")
    revise.add_argument("plan_id", help="Saved plan whose table, communities and scientific context are retained")
    revise.add_argument("csv_file", type=Path, help="Edited original interventions.csv in UTF-8")
    revise.add_argument("--title", help="Revised plan title; defaults to the original title")
    revise.add_argument("--purpose", help="Revised purpose; defaults to the original purpose")
    revise.add_argument("--column-mapping", type=Path,
                        help="JSON object mapping native plan fields to original CSV headings; null leaves a field unmapped")
    attach = commands.add_parser(
        "plan-attach-watershed", help="Save the next plan revision with its completed regional watershed context")
    attach.add_argument("plan_id")
    attach.add_argument("report_id", help="Saved watershed-<20 hex> report from the existing regional registry")
    attach.add_argument("--title", help="Revised plan title; defaults to the original title")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        workspace = Workspace(args.workspace)
        if args.command == "overview":
            result = communities.overview(workspace)
        elif args.command == "plan-attach-watershed":
            previous = communities.get_plan(workspace, args.plan_id)
            context = {name: previous["context"].get(name) for name in (
                "source_collection_ids", "grid_id", "baseline_run_id", "scenario_run_ids", "delivery_id")}
            context["watershed_context_id"] = args.report_id
            selected = {
                "table_id": previous["table_id"], "previous_plan_id": previous["id"],
                "title": args.title if args.title is not None else previous["title"],
                "purpose": previous["purpose"], "selection": previous["selection"],
                "context": context, "notes": previous["notes"],
                "interventions": previous["interventions"],
            }
            if previous.get("intervention_import") is not None:
                selected["intervention_import"] = previous["intervention_import"]
            result = communities.save_plan(workspace, selected)
        elif args.command == "plan-revise-csv":
            previous = communities.get_plan(workspace, args.plan_id)
            original = args.csv_file.read_bytes()
            imported = {
                "schema": "upstate.intervention-csv-import/v1",
                "selection": previous["selection"],
                "source": {"filename": args.csv_file.name, "media_type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8",
                           "bytes": len(original), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(),
                           "text": original.decode("utf-8")},
            }
            if args.column_mapping is not None:
                imported["column_mapping"] = read_json(args.column_mapping)
            context = {name: previous["context"].get(name) for name in (
                "source_collection_ids", "grid_id", "baseline_run_id", "scenario_run_ids", "delivery_id",
                "watershed_context_id")}
            result = communities.save_plan(workspace, {
                "table_id": previous["table_id"], "previous_plan_id": previous["id"],
                "title": args.title if args.title is not None else previous["title"],
                "purpose": args.purpose if args.purpose is not None else previous["purpose"],
                "selection": previous["selection"], "context": context,
                "notes": previous["notes"], "intervention_import": imported,
            })
        elif args.command in {"table", "plan", "report"}:
            kind = {"table": communities.TABLE_KIND, "plan": communities.PLAN_KIND,
                    "report": communities.REPORT_KIND}[args.command]
            result = workspace._get(kind, args.id)
        else:
            action = {"table-import": "community.table.import", "plan-save": "community.plan.save",
                      "report-build": "community.report.build"}[args.command]
            result = communities.invoke(workspace, action, read_json(args.selection))
        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))
        return 0
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
        print(json.dumps({"error": {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}},
                         ensure_ascii=False), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Receive a saved Community planning report into the ordered scientific report."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import tempfile

from . import observed_context
from .common import (atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest, held,
                     identifier, read_json, verify_file)
from .communities import REPORT_KIND

SCHEMA = "upstate.community-report-context/v1"
VERSION = "3"
RECIPE = "community-scientific-report.json"
MANIFEST = "sources.json"


def _relative(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or "\\" in value or "\0" in value:
        raise ValueError("Original Community report members need canonical relative names")
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    if path.is_absolute() or not path.parts or ".." in path.parts or path.as_posix() != value:
        raise ValueError("Original Community report members must stay in their report")
    return path


def _copy(source, target, expected):
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if target.exists():
        if target.stat().st_size != expected["bytes"] or file_digest(target) != expected["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("A retained Community report member changed: " + str(target))
        return
    handle, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".write-community-source-", dir=target.parent)
    try:
        size, sha = 0, hashlib.sha256()
        with os.fdopen(handle, "wb") as output, open(source, "rb") as original:
            for block in iter(lambda: original.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                output.write(block)
                size += len(block)
                sha.update(block)
            output.flush()
            os.fsync(output.fileno())
        if size != expected["bytes"] or sha.hexdigest() != expected["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("The original Community report changed during receiving")
        os.replace(temporary, target)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)


def _text(value):
    if value is None:
        return "Unspecified"
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "Yes" if value else "No"
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return "\n".join(str(key).replace("_", " ") + ": " + _text(item)
                         for key, item in value.items()) or "None recorded"
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return "\n".join(_text(item) for item in value) or "None recorded"
    return str(value)


def _table(columns, rows):
    return {"kind": "table", "columns": columns,
            "rows": [[_text(value) for value in row] for row in rows]}


def _metadata_rows(value, prefix=""):
    """Show every retained metadata leaf without serializing a JSON cell."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        rows = []
        for key, item in value.items():
            label = str(key).replace("_", " ")
            rows.extend(_metadata_rows(item, prefix + " / " + label if prefix else label))
        return rows or [[prefix or "Value", "None recorded"]]
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        if any(isinstance(item, (dict, list, tuple)) for item in value):
            return [row for number, item in enumerate(value, 1)
                    for row in _metadata_rows(item, prefix + " / item " + str(number))]
    return [[prefix or "Value", _text(value)]]


def _coverage(known, total):
    return _text(known) + " of " + _text(total) + " block groups"


def _summary_blocks(summary, income):
    total = summary.get("geoid_count")
    currency = income.get("currency") or "currency unspecified"
    return [
        "Selected block groups: " + _text(total) + ". Complete totals require a value for every selected "
        "block group. Known-group subtotals retain the available source values and their coverage.",
        _table(["Whole-block-group measure", "Complete selected total", "Known-group subtotal",
                "Groups with a value"], [
            [label, summary.get(key), summary.get(key + "_known_sum"),
             _coverage(summary.get(key + "_known_groups"), total)]
            for label, key in (("People", "population_total"), ("Households", "households_total"),
                               ("Households below poverty", "poverty_households_total"))
        ]),
        _table(["Poverty measure", "Saved value", "Source support"], [
            ["Selected-group household poverty (%)", summary.get("household_poverty_percent"),
             "Available only when every selected group has both household and poverty counts"],
            ["Known paired-group household poverty (%)", summary.get("household_poverty_known_percent"),
             _coverage(summary.get("household_poverty_known_groups"), total)],
            ["Paired poverty numerator (households)", summary.get("household_poverty_numerator"),
             "Households below poverty in groups with both counts"],
            ["Paired household denominator (households)", summary.get("household_poverty_denominator"),
             "All households in the same paired groups"],
        ]),
        "The poverty percentage uses the saved paired household numerator and denominator, rather than "
        "an average of block-group percentages. A zero household denominator has no percentage.",
        _table(["Income and membership context", "Saved value"], [
            ["Income reference (" + currency + ")", income.get("threshold")],
            ["Income reference source", income.get("source_reference")],
            ["Block groups with a known median income", _coverage(summary.get("income_known_groups"), total)],
            ["Known block-group medians below the source reference",
             _text(summary.get("below_state_median_count")) + " of " + _text(summary.get("income_known_groups"))],
            ["Lowest block-group median (" + currency + ")", summary.get("median_income_min")],
            ["Highest block-group median (" + currency + ")", summary.get("median_income_max")],
            ["Block groups with multiple original memberships", summary.get("shared_membership_groups")],
        ]),
        "Income bounds describe the individual block-group medians. No pooled community median or mean "
        "household income is calculated. Each selected block group appears once in the overall totals.",
    ]


def _scope_blocks(rows, scope_label):
    blocks = []
    for row in rows:
        total = row.get("geoid_count")
        blocks.append(_table([scope_label + " measure", "Complete total", "Known-group subtotal",
                              "Groups with a value"], [
            [str(row.get("label") or row.get("scope_id") or "Unnamed") + " — " + label,
             row.get(key), row.get(key + "_known_sum"),
             _coverage(row.get(key + "_known_groups"), total)]
            for label, key in (("people", "population_total"), ("households", "households_total"),
                               ("households below poverty", "poverty_households_total"))
        ]))
        blocks.append(_table([scope_label + " identity / paired poverty", "Saved value"], [
            ["Source scope ID", row.get("scope_id")],
            ["Selected block groups", total],
            ["Selected-group household poverty (%)", row.get("household_poverty_percent")],
            ["Known paired-group household poverty (%)", row.get("household_poverty_known_percent")],
            ["Paired-group coverage", _coverage(row.get("household_poverty_known_groups"), total)],
            ["Paired poverty numerator (households)", row.get("household_poverty_numerator")],
            ["Paired household denominator (households)", row.get("household_poverty_denominator")],
        ]))
    return blocks


def _revision_change_rows(revision):
    rows = []
    for change in revision.get("changes", []):
        before, after = change.get("before"), change.get("after")
        label = str(change.get("intervention_id", "")) + " / " + str(change.get("title", ""))
        if isinstance(before, dict) or isinstance(after, dict):
            left = dict(_metadata_rows(before)) if isinstance(before, dict) else {}
            right = dict(_metadata_rows(after)) if isinstance(after, dict) else {}
            for field in dict.fromkeys([*left, *right]):
                rows.append([change.get("change"), label, str(change.get("field", "")) + " / " + field,
                             left.get(field, "Absent from this edition"),
                             right.get(field, "Absent from this edition")])
        else:
            rows.append([change.get("change"), label, change.get("field"), before, after])
    return rows


def _revision_blocks(revision):
    selection = revision.get("selection", {})
    before_summary, after_summary = (selection.get(name, {}) for name in ("before_summary", "after_summary"))
    costs = revision.get("costs", {})
    before_cost, after_cost = (costs.get(name, {}) for name in ("before", "after"))
    context = revision.get("scientific_context", {})
    csv = revision.get("received_csv", {})
    changes = revision.get("plan_changes", []) + context.get("identifier_changes", [])
    blocks = [
        _table(["Saved revision", "Original value"], [
            ["Previous plan", revision.get("previous_plan_id")],
            ["Current plan", revision.get("plan_id")],
            ["Previous revision number", revision.get("previous_revision_number")],
            ["Current revision number", revision.get("revision_number")],
            ["Original community table", revision.get("table_id")],
            ["Original community source SHA256", revision.get("source_sha256")],
        ]),
        _table(["Recorded change count", "Value"], _metadata_rows(revision.get("counts", {}))),
        selection.get("basis") or "Selection changes describe whole-block-group membership.",
        _table(["Selected membership / source measure", "Previous edition", "Current edition"], [
            ["Utility filters", selection.get("before", {}).get("utility_ids"),
             selection.get("after", {}).get("utility_ids")],
            ["Watershed filters", selection.get("before", {}).get("watershed_ids"),
             selection.get("after", {}).get("watershed_ids")],
            ["Whole block groups", before_summary.get("geoid_count"), after_summary.get("geoid_count")],
            ["Selected GEOIDs", before_summary.get("geoids"), after_summary.get("geoids")],
            ["Added selected GEOIDs", "Not applicable", selection.get("added_geoids")],
            ["Removed selected GEOIDs", selection.get("removed_geoids"), "Not applicable"],
            ["Complete population total", before_summary.get("population_total"),
             after_summary.get("population_total")],
            ["Groups with population", _coverage(before_summary.get("population_total_known_groups"),
                                                before_summary.get("geoid_count")),
             _coverage(after_summary.get("population_total_known_groups"), after_summary.get("geoid_count"))],
            ["Complete household total", before_summary.get("households_total"),
             after_summary.get("households_total")],
            ["Groups with households", _coverage(before_summary.get("households_total_known_groups"),
                                                before_summary.get("geoid_count")),
             _coverage(after_summary.get("households_total_known_groups"), after_summary.get("geoid_count"))],
        ]),
        costs.get("basis") or "Entered planning estimates retain their original availability.",
        _table(["Entered planning estimates (" + str(costs.get("currency") or "currency unspecified") + ")",
                "Previous edition", "Current edition"], [
            ["Entered total", before_cost.get("entered_total_usd"), after_cost.get("entered_total_usd")],
            ["Interventions with an estimate", before_cost.get("known_estimate_count"),
             after_cost.get("known_estimate_count")],
            ["Interventions with an unspecified estimate", before_cost.get("unknown_estimate_count"),
             after_cost.get("unknown_estimate_count")],
        ]),
        _table(["Saved signed change", "Value"], [
            ["Current minus previous entered estimates (USD)", costs.get("entered_estimate_difference_usd")],
        ]),
        _table(["Change", "Intervention", "Original field", "Previous value", "Current value"],
               _revision_change_rows(revision)),
    ]
    if changes:
        blocks.append(_table(["Plan / scientific selection field", "Previous value", "Current value"],
                             [[row.get("field"), row.get("before"), row.get("after")] for row in changes]))
    blocks.append(_table(["Revision source lineage", "Previous edition", "Current edition"], [
        ["Scientific snapshot SHA256", context.get("before_snapshot_sha256"), context.get("after_snapshot_sha256")],
        ["Scientific snapshot changed", "Not applicable", context.get("snapshot_changed")],
        ["Received intervention CSV SHA256", csv.get("before_sha256"), csv.get("after_sha256")],
        ["Received CSV parent plan", csv.get("before_import_plan_id"), csv.get("after_import_plan_id")],
    ]))
    return blocks


def _intervention_import_blocks(imported):
    """Explain the original received columns without reparsing its saved import."""
    original = imported.get("source") or {}
    summary = imported.get("summary") or {}
    blocks = [
        "This is the retained intervention CSV intake. Its counts compare the original received rows "
        "with the plan recorded at intake. Later editor changes and scientific-context revisions are "
        "described separately by the saved-plan change register.",
        _table(["Original received file / comparison", "Retained value"], [
            ["Original filename", original.get("filename")],
            ["Original media type", original.get("media_type")],
            ["Original UTF-8 bytes", original.get("bytes")],
            ["Original file SHA256", original.get("sha256")],
            ["Community table at intake", imported.get("table_id")],
            ["Plan used for the intake comparison", imported.get("previous_plan_id")],
            ["Received programme rows", summary.get("row_count")],
            ["Original row ordering", summary.get("order_basis")],
        ]),
        _table(["Original intake change", "Count", "Original intervention IDs"], [
            [label, len(summary[key]) if isinstance(summary.get(key), list) else None,
             summary.get(key)]
            for label, key in (("Added", "added_ids"), ("Changed", "changed_ids"),
                               ("Removed", "removed_ids"), ("Unchanged", "unchanged_ids"))
        ]),
    ]
    fields = imported.get("field_provenance") or []
    if fields:
        meanings = {
            "original-column": "Original received column; native field validation",
            "generated-source-row-id": "Identifier generated from original file SHA256 and record number",
            "native-default": "Unmapped native field; its original default or unspecified value applies",
        }
        blocks.extend([
            "Column numbers are one-based positions in the unchanged received header. An unmapped "
            "field uses the native default or an unspecified value. Blank estimates remain unspecified. "
            "When the received identifier is absent or blank, the retained row identifier is generated "
            "from that original file identity and record number.",
            _table(["Plan field", "Original CSV column", "Column number", "Recorded interpretation"], [
                [row.get("field"), row.get("source_column") or "Unmapped",
                 row.get("source_column_number") if row.get("source_column_number") is not None
                 else "Not applicable",
                 meanings.get(row.get("basis"), row.get("basis"))]
                for row in fields
            ]),
        ])
    else:
        blocks.append("This original intake does not record an explicit column mapping. Its unchanged "
                      "received CSV and original import record remain attached; no later column "
                      "assignment is inferred.")
    if imported.get("source_headers"):
        blocks.append(_table(["Original column number", "Unchanged received heading"], [
            [number, heading] for number, heading in enumerate(imported["source_headers"], 1)
        ]))
    if imported.get("rows"):
        blocks.extend([
            "The record number counts received data records. The source line is the starting physical "
            "CSV line, so quoted multiline records can span more than one line. These identities describe "
            "the original intake even when a later saved plan edits, removes or reorders an intervention.",
            _table(["Original data record", "Starting CSV line", "Retained intervention ID"], [
                [row.get("record"), row.get("source_line"), row.get("id")]
                for row in imported["rows"]
            ]),
        ])
    normalizations = summary.get("normalized_geographies") or []
    if normalizations:
        blocks.extend([
            "The following original geography identifiers were normalized by the recorded intake against "
            "the original Community table. The received CSV keeps its unchanged original text.",
            _table(["Starting CSV line", "Plan field", "Original received identifier", "Saved identifier"], [
                [row.get("row"), row.get("column"), row.get("original"), row.get("resolved")]
                for row in normalizations
            ]),
        ])
    if summary.get("derived_columns") or summary.get("additional_columns"):
        blocks.extend([
            "Unmapped derived and additional columns stay in the original CSV. They did not replace "
            "the plan's native context or become intervention fields.",
            _table(["Original unused column class", "Received headings"], [
                ["Derived context columns", summary.get("derived_columns")],
                ["Additional original columns", summary.get("additional_columns")],
            ]),
        ])
    blocks.append("received-interventions.csv and INTERVENTION_IMPORT.json carry the complete original "
                  "file and intake record. The saved plan and report retain the authored intervention "
                  "values separately; reading this source does not replay or modify the intake.")
    return blocks


def _sections(payload, report_id, report_sha256):
    plan = payload["plan"]
    source = plan.get("source") or {}
    income = plan.get("metadata", {}).get("income_reference", {})
    currency = income.get("currency") or "currency unspecified"
    aggregate = plan.get("summaries", {}).get("all", {})
    utilities = payload.get("utility_summaries", [])
    cost = plan.get("cost_summary", {})
    sections = [
        ["Community planning context", [
            plan.get("purpose") or "Saved utility and community intervention programme.",
            "This section retains the selected whole census block groups, utility memberships and saved "
            "intervention decisions. Population and household counts describe the source geographies. "
            "Utility service populations describe their whole systems; overlapping utility and watershed "
            "summaries retain their original membership and are not additive.",
            "Interventions, priorities, progress labels and cost estimates are the saved planning decisions. "
            "They are separate from measured environmental outcomes and modeled export reductions.",
            _table(["Original selection", "Saved value"], [
                ["Plan", plan.get("title")], ["Plan ID", plan["id"]],
                ["Saved report", report_id], ["Original report JSON SHA256", report_sha256],
            ]),
            *_summary_blocks(aggregate, income),
        ]],
        ["Original community source", [
            _table(["Source field", "Saved value"], [
                ["Source title", source.get("title")],
                ["Original source URI", source.get("uri")],
                ["Source vintage", source.get("vintage")],
                ["Source collection", source.get("collection_id")],
                ["Source member", source.get("source_id")],
                ["Original source SHA256", source.get("sha256")],
            ]),
            _table(["Retained original file", "Saved value"],
                   _metadata_rows(source.get("original"), "Original file")),
            *plan.get("metadata", {}).get("limitations", []),
        ]],
        ["Selected utilities and source communities", [
            _table(["Utility", "Approximate whole-system service population", "Service population basis",
                    "Original service population source"], [
                [row.get("label"), row.get("approximate_service_population"),
                 row.get("service_population_basis"), row.get("service_population_source")]
                for row in utilities
            ]),
            *_scope_blocks(utilities, "Utility"),
            "The following values belong to each original whole block group. Memberships identify the "
            "selected utility and watershed associations without dividing household or population counts.",
            _table(["Block group", "Population", "Households",
                    "Median household income (" + currency + ")", "Households below poverty"], [
                [row.get("geoid"), row.get("population"), row.get("households"),
                 row.get("median_household_income"), row.get("households_below_poverty")]
                for row in payload.get("communities", [])
            ]),
            _table(["Block group", "Utility memberships", "HUC12 memberships", "Original source notes"], [
                [row.get("geoid"), row.get("utility_ids"), row.get("watershed_ids"), row.get("source_notes")]
                for row in payload.get("communities", [])
            ]),
        ]],
        ["Selected watershed community context", [
            "These totals retain whole block groups associated with each selected watershed. Groups shared "
            "by watersheds remain present in each membership summary; totals across watersheds cannot be added.",
            *_scope_blocks(payload.get("watershed_summaries", []), "Watershed"),
        ]],
        ["Ordered intervention programme", [
            "The original editable interventions.csv accompanies this report. When this plan received an edited "
            "CSV, its unchanged received-interventions.csv and INTERVENTION_IMPORT.json accompany it too.",
            _table(["Planning cost coverage", "Saved value"], [
                ["Interventions", cost.get("intervention_count")],
                ["Interventions with an entered estimate", cost.get("known_estimate_count")],
                ["Total of entered estimates (USD)", cost.get("known_estimate_total")],
            ]),
            "The cost total includes entered estimates only. An unspecified cost is an open planning input; "
            "it does not become a zero estimate or a measured economic benefit.",
            _table(["Order / intervention", "Priority / recorded status", "Utility / HUC12", "Strategy",
                    "Estimated USD"], [
                [str(row.get("position", "")) + " / " + str(row.get("title", "")),
                 str(row.get("priority", "")) + " / " + str(row.get("status", "")),
                 str(row.get("utility_id", "")) + " / " + str(row.get("watershed_id", "")),
                 row.get("strategy"), row.get("cost_estimate_usd")]
                for row in payload.get("interventions", [])
            ]),
            _table(["Order / intervention", "Owner", "Reason", "Next step"], [
                [str(row.get("position", "")) + " / " + str(row.get("title", "")),
                 row.get("owner"), row.get("reason"), row.get("next_step")]
                for row in payload.get("interventions", [])
            ]),
        ]],
    ]
    imported = plan.get("intervention_import")
    if imported:
        sections.append(["Original intervention intake and field mapping",
                         _intervention_import_blocks(imported)])
    revision = payload.get("plan_revision")
    if revision:
        sections.insert(1, ["Changes from previous saved Community plan", _revision_blocks(revision)])
    regional = payload.get("regional_watershed_context")
    if regional:
        hucs = regional.get("hucs", [])
        coverage = regional.get("classification_coverage") or {}
        sections.append(["Original regional watershed planning context", [
            *payload.get("watershed_scope_notes", []),
            "A complete South Carolina query with zero selected-class matches describes the named target "

    identity = {"schema": SCHEMA, "version": VERSION, "project_id": workspace.project["id"],

        inputs.append(describe_file(directory, directory / "retained" / "saved-report.json"))
        title = (report.get("title") or payload["title"]) + " — community planning context"

        return result


def _archived_copy(original, target, expected):
    """Retain one verified ZIP member without replacing an earlier received byte."""
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if target.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Keep archived Community members as regular received files")
    if target.exists():
        verify_file(target.parent, {**expected, "path": target.name})
        return
    handle, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".write-community-member-", dir=target.parent)
    try:
        size, sha = 0, hashlib.sha256()
        with os.fdopen(handle, "wb") as output:
            while block := original.read(1024 * 1024):
                size += len(block)
                if size > expected["bytes"]:
                    raise ValueError("An archived Community member exceeds its retained length")
                sha.update(block)
                output.write(block)
            output.flush()
            os.fsync(output.fileno())
        if size != expected["bytes"] or sha.hexdigest() != expected["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("An archived Community member differs from its retained bytes")
        try:
            os.link(temporary, target)
        except FileExistsError:
            verify_file(target.parent, {**expected, "path": target.name})
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)


def prepare_archive(workspace, archive_path, report_record, *, original_project_id,
                    report_sha256, delivery_id=None, import_source=True):
    """Receive an original report edition as source, retaining its donor identities.

    The destination is an actual Workspace. Original Community IDs remain source
    provenance; this entry point does not create editable table or plan records.
    """
    import stat
    import uuid
    import zipfile

    donor = str(uuid.UUID(original_project_id))
    if donor != original_project_id:
        raise ValueError("Use the exact original Community project UUID")
    report_sha256 = identifier(report_sha256)
    report_record = Path(report_record).absolute()
    record_bytes = report_record.read_bytes()
    report = json.loads(record_bytes)
    key = identifier(report.get("id"))
    if (report.get("schema") != "upstate.community-reports/v1"
            or digest({name: value for name, value in report.items() if name != "id"}) != key):
        raise ValueError("The original saved Community report record changed")
    selection_id = identifier(report.get("selection_id"))
    if digest({"schema": "upstate.community-report-selection/v1", "plan_id": report["plan_id"],
               "title": report["title"], "format_version": report["format_version"]}) != selection_id:
        raise ValueError("The saved Community report selection changed")
    files = report.get("files")
    required = {"REPORT.json", "community-report.json", "community-report.zip"}
    if not isinstance(files, dict) or not required <= files.keys():
        raise ValueError("Receive the complete original Community report inventory")
    prefix = "community-reports/" + selection_id + "/"
    for name, item in files.items():
        _relative(name)
        if (not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("path") != prefix + name
                or type(item.get("bytes")) is not int or item["bytes"] < 0):
            raise ValueError("A Community report member belongs to another saved edition")
        identifier(item.get("sha256"))
    if files["community-report.json"]["sha256"] != report_sha256:
        raise ValueError("The selected original Community report JSON changed")
    if donor == workspace.project["id"] and workspace._get(REPORT_KIND, key) != report:
        raise ValueError("The same-project Community source must match its original saved record")
    archive_path = Path(archive_path).absolute()
    if archive_path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Receive the original Community archive as a regular file")
    expected_archive = files["community-report.zip"]
    record_descriptor = {"path": report_record.name, "bytes": len(record_bytes),
                         "sha256": hashlib.sha256(record_bytes).hexdigest()}
    identity = {
        "schema": SCHEMA, "version": VERSION, "receiving": "original-report-archive-v1",
        "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "original_project_id": donor,
        "report_id": key, "report_sha256": report_sha256,
        "archive": {name: expected_archive[name] for name in ("bytes", "sha256")},
        "saved_record": {name: record_descriptor[name] for name in ("bytes", "sha256")},
        "producer_sha256": file_digest(Path(__file__)),
        "report_loader_edition": observed_context.EDITION,
    }
    operation_id = digest(identity)
    directory = workspace.root / "community-report-contexts" / operation_id
    lock = workspace.root / "locks" / ("community-report-context-" + operation_id + ".lock")

    def file_state(value):
        return (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns)

    with held(lock), archive_path.open("rb") as source:
        initial = os.fstat(source.fileno())
        if not stat.S_ISREG(initial.st_mode) or initial.st_size != expected_archive["bytes"]:
            raise ValueError("The original Community archive has a different size or file type")
        checksum = hashlib.sha256()
        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            checksum.update(block)
        if checksum.hexdigest() != expected_archive["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("The original complete Community report archive changed")
        source.seek(0)
        inputs = []
        with zipfile.ZipFile(source) as bundle:
            members = bundle.infolist()
            names = [item.filename for item in members]
            expected_names = set(files) - {"community-report.zip"}
            if len(names) != len(set(names)) or set(names) != expected_names:
                raise ValueError("The original Community ZIP member inventory differs")
            for member in members:
                _relative(member.filename)
                mode = (member.external_attr >> 16) & 0xFFFF
                if (member.is_dir() or member.flag_bits & 1 or stat.S_ISLNK(mode)
                        or stat.S_IFMT(mode) not in (0, stat.S_IFREG)
                        or member.file_size != files[member.filename]["bytes"]):
                    raise ValueError("Keep each original Community ZIP member as its declared regular file")
            # Every member is length/hash/CRC checked before its JSON is trusted.
            for name in sorted(expected_names):
                target = directory / "retained" / name
                if not target.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(directory.resolve()):
                    raise ValueError("Keep original Community members inside their receiving directory")
                with bundle.open(name) as original:
                    _archived_copy(original, target, files[name])
                inputs.append(describe_file(directory, target))
        retained = directory / "retained"
        index = read_json(retained / "REPORT.json")
        payload = read_json(retained / "community-report.json")
        plan, table = payload.get("plan", {}), payload.get("original_table", {})
        for kind, record, expected in (("community-plans", plan, report["plan_id"]),
                                       ("community-tables", table, report["table_id"])):
            if (record.get("id") != expected or record.get("schema") != "upstate." + kind + "/v1"
                    or digest({name: value for name, value in record.items() if name != "id"}) != expected):
                raise ValueError("The archived Community " + kind + " identity changed")
        if (index.get("schema") != "upstate.community-report-files/v1"
                or payload.get("schema") != "upstate.community-report/v1"
                or any(index.get(name) != report.get(name) for name in ("plan_id", "table_id", "title"))
                or payload.get("title") != report["title"] or plan.get("table_id") != table["id"]
                or report.get("source") != plan.get("source") or plan.get("source") != table.get("source")
                or plan.get("context", {}).get("snapshot_sha256") != report.get("context_snapshot_sha256")):
            raise ValueError("The archived report differs from its original plan, table or scientific context")
        indexed = index.get("files")
        if not isinstance(indexed, dict) or set(indexed) != set(files) - {"REPORT.json", "community-report.zip"}:
            raise ValueError("The archived Community report index is incomplete")
        for name, item in indexed.items():
            if any(item.get(field) != files[name].get(field) for field in ("path", "bytes", "sha256")):
                raise ValueError("The archived original report index changed: " + name)
        if report.get("plan_revision") != payload.get("plan_revision"):
            raise ValueError("The archived Community plan revision register changed")
        revision = payload.get("plan_revision")
        if revision:
            if (revision.get("schema") != "upstate.community-plan-revision/v1"
                    or revision.get("plan_id") != plan["id"]
                    or revision.get("previous_plan_id") != plan.get("previous_plan_id")
                    or revision.get("table_id") != table["id"]
                    or not {"plan-revision-summary.json", "plan-revision-changes.csv",
                            "previous-plan.json"} <= expected_names
                    or read_json(retained / "plan-revision-summary.json") != revision):
                raise ValueError("Receive the original complete Community revision register")
            previous = read_json(retained / "previous-plan.json")
            if (previous.get("id") != revision["previous_plan_id"]
                    or digest({name: value for name, value in previous.items() if name != "id"}) != previous["id"]):
                raise ValueError("The archived previous Community plan changed")
        # Keep the byte-exact saved record and original ZIP alongside all members.
        _copy(report_record, retained / "saved-report.json", record_descriptor)
        inputs.append(describe_file(directory, retained / "saved-report.json"))
        source.seek(0)
        _archived_copy(source, retained / "community-report.zip", expected_archive)
        inputs.append(describe_file(directory, retained / "community-report.zip"))
        if (file_state(os.fstat(source.fileno())) != file_state(initial)
                or file_state(archive_path.lstat()) != file_state(initial)):
            raise ValueError("The original Community archive changed during receiving")
        title = report["title"] + " — community planning context"
        recipe = {
            "schema": observed_context.SCHEMA, "title": title,
            "edition": "community-planning-archive-" + VERSION,
            "report_context_kind": "community_planning",
            "project_id": donor, "community_report_id": key, "plan_id": plan["id"],
            "report_sha256": report_sha256, "inputs": inputs,
            "sections": _sections(payload, key, report_sha256),
            "source_links": [item["path"] for item in inputs], "figures": [],
            "archive_receiving": identity,
        }
        atomic_json(directory / RECIPE, recipe, immutable=True)
        source_id = "community-planning-report-" + operation_id[:20]
        manifest = {
            "schema": "upstate.sources/v1", "title": title,
            "scope": {"original_project_id": donor, "plan_id": plan["id"],
                      "community_report_id": key, "report_sha256": report_sha256},
            "entries": [{
                "id": source_id, "kind": "document", "title": title,
                "role": "community-planning-report-context", "path": RECIPE,
                "uri": "workspace://" + donor + "/" + REPORT_KIND + "/" + key,
                "vintage": "Retained Community report format " + str(report["format_version"])
                           + "; selection " + selection_id,
                "sha256": file_digest(directory / RECIPE),
                "metadata": {"report_schema": observed_context.SCHEMA,
                             "report_context_kind": "community_planning",
                             "plan_id": plan["id"], "community_report_id": key},
                "companions": inputs,
            }],
        }
        atomic_json(directory / MANIFEST, manifest, immutable=True)
        result = {**identity, "id": operation_id, "title": title, "source_id": source_id,
                  "community_report_id": key, "plan_id": plan["id"],
                  "original_member_count": len(files),
                  "files": [describe_file(workspace.root, directory / name) for name in (MANIFEST, RECIPE)]
                           + [describe_file(workspace.root, retained / "community-report.zip")]}
        if import_source:
            collection = workspace.import_sources(directory / MANIFEST)
            choice = {"source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": source_id}
            result.update(source=choice, observed_context_binding=observed_context.bind(
                workspace, {"observed_context_sources": [choice]}))
            atomic_json(directory / "registered-context.json", result, immutable=True)
            result["delivery_selection"] = delivery_selection(workspace, choice, delivery_id)
            result["selected_delivery_id"] = delivery_id
        return result

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import stat
import tempfile
import uuid
import zipfile

from .common import (atomic_json, canonical, describe_file, digest,
                     held, identifier, relative_file, verify_file)

SCHEMA = "upstate.community-report-handover/v1"
VERSION = 1
ROOT = "community-report-handovers"
MANIFEST = "HANDOVER.json"
RECORD = "saved-report.json"
REPORT_ARCHIVE = "community-report.zip"
BUNDLE = "community-source-handover.zip"
MEMBERS = {MANIFEST, RECORD, REPORT_ARCHIVE}
# Only the two small metadata records are read into memory. Report ZIPs stream.
MAX_METADATA_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024
BLOCK_BYTES = 1024 * 1024


def _state(value):
    return (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns)


def _descriptor(value):
    if (not isinstance(value, dict) or type(value.get("bytes")) is not int
            or value["bytes"] < 0):
        raise ValueError("A handover member needs its original byte count and hash")
    identifier(value.get("sha256"))
    return value


def _json(body):
    try:
        value = json.loads(body)
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ValueError("Expected a JSON object")
        canonical(value)
        return value
    except (UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
        raise ValueError("The original handover metadata is not a valid JSON object") from error


def _member_name(name):
    if (not isinstance(name, str) or not name or "\\" in name or "\0" in name
            or PurePosixPath(name).is_absolute()
            or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in name.split("/"))):
        raise ValueError("Keep the original report's relative member names")
    return name


def _record_contract(record, report_id, report_sha256):
    """Validate the original registry record without adding or changing fields."""
    if (record.get("schema") != "upstate.community-reports/v1"
            or ("id" in record and record["id"] != identifier(report_id))
            or digest({key: value for key, value in record.items() if key != "id"})
               != identifier(report_id)):
        raise ValueError("The original Community report registry record changed")
    for field in ("plan_id", "table_id", "selection_id"):
        identifier(record.get(field))
    if (type(record.get("format_version")) is not int or record["format_version"] < 1
            or not isinstance(record.get("title"), str) or not record["title"].strip()):
        raise ValueError("The original report format and title are required")
    selection = {"schema": "upstate.community-report-selection/v1",
                 "plan_id": record["plan_id"], "title": record["title"],
                 "format_version": record["format_version"]}
    if digest(selection) != record["selection_id"]:
        raise ValueError("The original Community report selection changed")
    files = record.get("files")
    if (not isinstance(files, dict)
            or not {"REPORT.json", "community-report.json", REPORT_ARCHIVE} <= set(files)):
        raise ValueError("Receive the complete saved Community report inventory")
    prefix = "community-reports/" + record["selection_id"] + "/"
    for name, item in files.items():
        _member_name(name)
        _descriptor(item)
        if item.get("path") != prefix + name:
            raise ValueError("A Community report member belongs to another saved edition")
    if files["community-report.json"]["sha256"] != identifier(report_sha256):
        raise ValueError("The selected original Community report JSON changed")
    return files


def _manifest_contract(value, record):
    if (value.get("schema") != SCHEMA or type(value.get("version")) is not int
            or value["version"] != VERSION
            or digest({key: item for key, item in value.items() if key != "id"})
               != identifier(value.get("id"))):
        raise ValueError("The original source handover manifest changed")
    try:
        donor = str(uuid.UUID(value.get("original_project_id", "")))
    except (TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError) as error:
        raise ValueError("The original source project UUID is required") from error
    if donor != value["original_project_id"]:
        raise ValueError("Use the exact original source project UUID")
    files = value.get("files")
    if not isinstance(files, dict) or set(files) != {RECORD, REPORT_ARCHIVE}:
        raise ValueError("Receive the original report registry record and complete report ZIP")
    for item in files.values():
        _descriptor(item)
    original = _record_contract(record, value.get("report_id"), value.get("report_sha256"))
    for field in ("title", "format_version", "plan_id", "table_id"):
        if value.get(field) != record[field]:
            raise ValueError("Handover metadata differs from its original report: " + field)
    if type(value.get("member_count")) is not int or value["member_count"] != len(original):
        raise ValueError("The original report member count changed")
    if any(files[REPORT_ARCHIVE][field] != original[REPORT_ARCHIVE][field]
           for field in ("bytes", "sha256")):
        raise ValueError("The handover names another original report ZIP")


def _stream(source, target=None, expected=None):
    checksum, total = hashlib.sha256(), 0
    while True:
        block = source.read(BLOCK_BYTES)
        if not block:
            break
        total += len(block)
        if expected is not None and total > expected["bytes"]:
            raise ValueError("A handover member exceeds its original byte count")
        checksum.update(block)
        if target is not None:
            target.write(block)
    result = {"bytes": total, "sha256": checksum.hexdigest()}
    if expected is not None and any(result[key] != expected[key] for key in result):
        raise ValueError("A complete original handover member changed")
    return result


def _read_metadata(bundle, name, expected=None):
    member = bundle.getinfo(name)
    if member.file_size > MAX_METADATA_BYTES:
        raise ValueError("A source handover metadata record exceeds 8 MiB")
    with bundle.open(member) as original:
        body = original.read(MAX_METADATA_BYTES + 1)
    if len(body) != member.file_size:
        raise ValueError("The handover metadata byte count changed")
    if expected is not None and (len(body) != expected["bytes"]
            or hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() != expected["sha256"]):
        raise ValueError("The original saved report record changed")
    return _json(body)


@contextlib.contextmanager
def _opened(path, expected_sha256=None):
    path = Path(path).absolute()
    if path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Receive a source handover as an original regular file")
    if expected_sha256 is not None:
        identifier(expected_sha256)
    with path.open("rb") as original:
        before = os.fstat(original.fileno())
        if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode):
            raise ValueError("Receive a source handover as an original regular file")
        descriptor = _stream(original)
        if expected_sha256 is not None and descriptor["sha256"] != expected_sha256:
            raise ValueError("The uploaded source handover changed; select its original file")
        original.seek(0)
        try:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(original) as bundle:
                entries = bundle.infolist()
                names = [entry.filename for entry in entries]
                if len(names) != len(MEMBERS) or set(names) != MEMBERS:
                    raise ValueError("A source handover contains its three complete original members")
                for entry in entries:
                    mode = (entry.external_attr >> 16) & 0xFFFF
                    if (entry.is_dir() or entry.flag_bits & 1 or stat.S_ISLNK(mode)
                            or stat.S_IFMT(mode) not in (0, stat.S_IFREG)):
                        raise ValueError("Keep each source handover member as its original regular file")
                manifest = _read_metadata(bundle, MANIFEST)
                manifest_files = manifest.get("files")
                if not isinstance(manifest_files, dict) or set(manifest_files) != {RECORD, REPORT_ARCHIVE}:
                    raise ValueError("The source handover inventory is incomplete")
                for name, item in manifest_files.items():
                    _descriptor(item)
                    if bundle.getinfo(name).file_size != item["bytes"]:
                        raise ValueError("A source handover member size differs from its manifest")
                record = _read_metadata(bundle, RECORD, manifest_files[RECORD])
                _manifest_contract(manifest, record)
                with bundle.open(REPORT_ARCHIVE) as archive:
                    _stream(archive, expected=manifest_files[REPORT_ARCHIVE])
                if (_state(os.fstat(original.fileno())) != _state(before)
                        or _state(path.lstat()) != _state(before)):
                    raise ValueError("The original source handover changed while it was being read")
                yield original, bundle, manifest, record, descriptor
        except (zipfile.BadZipFile, NotImplementedError) as error:
            raise ValueError("The complete source handover ZIP could not be read") from error
        if (_state(os.fstat(original.fileno())) != _state(before)
                or _state(path.lstat()) != _state(before)):
            raise ValueError("The original source handover changed while it was being read")


def _summary(manifest, descriptor):
    return {key: manifest[key] for key in (
        "schema", "version", "id", "title", "original_project_id", "report_id",
        "report_sha256", "format_version", "plan_id", "table_id", "member_count")
    } | {"archive_sha256": descriptor["sha256"], "bytes": descriptor["bytes"]}


def inspect_archive(path, *, expected_sha256=None):
    """Read original source metadata without creating a project or importing data."""
    with _opened(path, expected_sha256) as (_, _bundle, manifest, _record, descriptor):
        return _summary(manifest, descriptor)


def _directory(workspace, key):
    root = workspace.root.resolve()
    directory = root / ROOT / identifier(key)
    if not directory.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError("Keep the source handover inside its original Workspace")
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return directory


def _zip_info(name, *, stored=False):
    info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, date_time=(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
    info.create_system = 3
    info.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16
    info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_STORED if stored else zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
    return info


def export(workspace, report_id, *, report_sha256):
    """Package the exact original registry bytes and report archive once."""
    report_id, report_sha256 = identifier(report_id), identifier(report_sha256)
    report = workspace._get("community-reports", report_id)
    record_path = relative_file(workspace.root, "community-reports/" + report_id + ".json")
    if record_path.stat().st_size > MAX_METADATA_BYTES:
        raise ValueError("A source handover metadata record exceeds 8 MiB")
    record_bytes = record_path.read_bytes()
    record = _json(record_bytes)
    if {**record, "id": report_id} != report:
        raise ValueError("The original Community report registry changed")
    files = _record_contract(record, report_id, report_sha256)
    # Verify the actual saved report's full inventory before its public handover.
    paths = {name: verify_file(workspace.root, item) for name, item in files.items()}
    return _package(workspace, record_bytes, report_id, report_sha256,
                    workspace.project["id"], paths[REPORT_ARCHIVE])


def export_archive(workspace, archive_path, report_record, *, original_project_id,
                   report_sha256):
    """Package a received original report when its donor Workspace is offline."""
    from . import community_report_context as context

    # The maintained archive receiver verifies the original saved record, every
    # ZIP member and scientific context in this actual receiving Workspace.
    prepared = context.prepare_archive(
        workspace, archive_path, report_record, original_project_id=original_project_id,
        report_sha256=report_sha256, import_source=False)
    archive = verify_file(workspace.root, next(
        item for item in prepared["files"]
        if item["path"].endswith("/retained/" + REPORT_ARCHIVE)))
    original_record = archive.parent / RECORD
    if original_record.stat().st_size > MAX_METADATA_BYTES:
        raise ValueError("A source handover metadata record exceeds 8 MiB")
    record_bytes = original_record.read_bytes()
    return _package(workspace, record_bytes, prepared["community_report_id"],
                    report_sha256, original_project_id, archive)


def _package(workspace, record_bytes, report_id, report_sha256, donor, archive_path):
    record = _json(record_bytes)
    files = _record_contract(record, report_id, report_sha256)
    manifest = {
        "schema": SCHEMA, "version": VERSION, "original_project_id": donor,
        "report_id": report_id, "report_sha256": report_sha256,
        "title": record["title"], "format_version": record["format_version"],
        "plan_id": record["plan_id"], "table_id": record["table_id"],
        "member_count": len(files),
        "files": {RECORD: {"bytes": len(record_bytes), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(record_bytes).hexdigest()},
                  REPORT_ARCHIVE: {key: files[REPORT_ARCHIVE][key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")}},
    }
    manifest["id"] = digest(manifest)
    _manifest_contract(manifest, record)
    key = manifest["id"]
    directory = _directory(workspace, key)
    path = directory / BUNDLE
    with held(workspace.root / "locks" / ("community-report-handover-" + key + ".lock")):
        if not path.exists():
            pending = None
            try:
                with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=directory, prefix=".write-community-handover-", delete=False) as output:
                    pending = Path(output.name)
                    with zipfile.ZipFile(output, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as bundle:
                        bundle.writestr(_zip_info(MANIFEST), canonical(manifest) + b"\n")
                        bundle.writestr(_zip_info(RECORD), record_bytes)
                        with archive_path.open("rb") as source:
                            with bundle.open(_zip_info(REPORT_ARCHIVE, stored=True), "w", force_zip64=True) as target:
                                _stream(source, target, manifest["files"][REPORT_ARCHIVE])
                    output.flush()
                    os.fsync(output.fileno())
                os.link(pending, path)
                pending.unlink()
                pending = None
                descriptor = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
                try:
                    os.fsync(descriptor)
                finally:
                    os.close(descriptor)
            finally:
                if pending is not None:
                    pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        result = inspect_archive(path)
        if result["id"] != key:
            raise ValueError("The retained source handover differs from its original report")
        result["files"] = [describe_file(workspace.root, path, title="Community report source handover",
                                         media_type="application/zip")]
        return result


def receive(workspace, path, *, expected_sha256, delivery_id=None):
    """Receive the complete source through the original archived-report importer."""
    from . import community_report_context as context

    with _opened(path, expected_sha256) as (original, bundle, manifest, record, descriptor):
        key = manifest["id"]
        directory = _directory(workspace, key)
        with held(workspace.root / "locks" / ("community-report-handover-" + key + ".lock")):
            for name in (RECORD, REPORT_ARCHIVE):
                with bundle.open(name) as member:
                    context._archived_copy(member, directory / name, manifest["files"][name])
            original.seek(0)
            context._archived_copy(original, directory / BUNDLE, descriptor)
            atomic_json(directory / MANIFEST, manifest, immutable=True)
            # Workspace registries store the ID in their filename. The existing
            # archive receiver takes the same ID-bearing record returned by _get.
            received_record = directory / "received-report.json"
            atomic_json(received_record, {**record, "id": manifest["report_id"]}, immutable=True)
    result = context.prepare_archive(
        workspace, directory / REPORT_ARCHIVE, received_record,
        original_project_id=manifest["original_project_id"],
        report_sha256=manifest["report_sha256"], delivery_id=delivery_id)
    retained = describe_file(workspace.root, directory / BUNDLE,
                            title="Original Community source handover", media_type="application/zip")
    result["handover"] = {**_summary(manifest, descriptor), "file": retained}
    result["files"] = [*result["files"], retained]
    return result


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    exporting = commands.add_parser("export")
    exporting.add_argument("report_id")
    exporting.add_argument("--report-sha256", required=True)
    packing = commands.add_parser("pack-archive")
    packing.add_argument("archive", type=Path)
    packing.add_argument("--report-record", type=Path, required=True)
    packing.add_argument("--original-project-id", required=True)
    packing.add_argument("--report-sha256", required=True)
    inspecting = commands.add_parser("inspect")
    inspecting.add_argument("archive", type=Path)
    inspecting.add_argument("--sha256", required=True)
    receiving = commands.add_parser("receive")
    receiving.add_argument("archive", type=Path)
    receiving.add_argument("--sha256", required=True)
    receiving.add_argument("--delivery-id")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == "inspect":
        result = inspect_archive(args.archive, expected_sha256=args.sha256)
    else:
        if not args.workspace:
            parser.error("--workspace is required for export, pack-archive and receive")
        from .workspace import Workspace
        workspace = Workspace(args.workspace)
        if args.command == "export":
            result = export(workspace, args.report_id, report_sha256=args.report_sha256)
        elif args.command == "pack-archive":
            result = export_archive(workspace, args.archive, args.report_record,
                                    original_project_id=args.original_project_id,
                                    report_sha256=args.report_sha256)
        else:
            result = receive(workspace, args.archive, expected_sha256=args.sha256,
                             delivery_id=args.delivery_id)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Receive completed Upper Savannah native models through the original operator."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import selectors
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import uuid

APP = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(APP))
from model.common import canonical, file_digest, held
from model.workspace import Workspace

def atomic(path, value, *, raw=False):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = value if raw else canonical(value) + b"\n"
    temporary = None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, prefix=".operator-receiving-", delete=False) as file:
            temporary = Path(file.name)
            file.write(data)
            file.flush()
            os.fsync(file.fileno())
        os.chmod(temporary, 0o600)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
        temporary = None
    finally:
        if temporary is not None:
            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)

def record(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    return {"path": str(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": file_digest(path)}

def checked_model(path, workspace_override=None):
    original = Path(path).read_bytes()
    value = json.loads(original)
    if value.get("schema") != "upstate.native-model-receiving/v1":
        raise ValueError("Select the actual original native-model receiving result")
    for field in ("workspace_id", "source_collection_id", "grid_id", "profiles", "scenarios",
                  "runs", "comparison_id", "delivery_selection"):
        if field not in value:
            raise ValueError("The original native handoff lacks " + field)
    workspace = Workspace(workspace_override or value["workspace_path"])
    if workspace.project["id"] != value["workspace_id"]:
        raise ValueError("The original native workspace identity differs")
    overview = workspace.overview()
    workspace._get("sources", value["source_collection_id"])
    workspace.get_grid(value["grid_id"])
    for kind in ("profiles", "scenarios"):
        for key in value[kind].values():
            workspace._get(kind, key)
    if len(set(value["runs"].values())) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Complete the original baseline and at least one alternative")
    for key in value["runs"].values():
        run = workspace.inspect_run(key)
        if run["state"] != "complete" or run["selection"]["grid_id"] != value["grid_id"]:
            raise ValueError("The selected original model run is incomplete or uses another grid")
    if not any(x["id"] == value["comparison_id"] for x in overview["comparisons"]):
        raise ValueError("The original paired run comparison is absent")
    selected = value["delivery_selection"]
    if selected["baseline_run_id"] not in value["runs"].values():
        raise ValueError("The delivery baseline differs from the native handoff")
    if not selected["scenario_run_ids"] or any(x not in value["runs"].values() for x in selected["scenario_run_ids"]):
        raise ValueError("The delivery alternatives differ from the native handoff")
    return value, workspace, original

def run_command(argv, output, name, *, timeout=None):
    log = output / (name + ".stdout")
    errors = output / (name + ".stderr")
    with log.open("wb") as stdout, errors.open("wb") as stderr:
        child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, env=os.environ.copy())
        try:
            code = child.wait(timeout=timeout)
        except BaseException:
            child.terminate()
            try:
                child.wait(timeout=20)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                child.kill()
                child.wait()
            raise
    if code:
        text = errors.read_text(errors="replace")[-12000:]
        raise RuntimeError(name + " exited " + str(code) + ": " + text)
    return log

class OperatorProcess:
    def __init__(self, application, workspace, state, received, output, name, upload_mib):
        self.error = output / (name + "-server.stderr")
        self.error_file = self.error.open("ab")
        self.child = subprocess.Popen([
            sys.executable, "-B", str(application / "operator/server.py"), "--workspace", str(workspace),
            "--operator-state", str(state), "--restore-directory", str(received), "--port", "0",
            "--upload-limit-mib", str(upload_mib)],
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=self.error_file, env=os.environ.copy(), text=True)
        try:
            selector = selectors.DefaultSelector()
            selector.register(self.child.stdout, selectors.EVENT_READ)
            try:
                if not selector.select(timeout=60):
                    raise RuntimeError("The original operator did not return its startup URL")
                line = self.child.stdout.readline()
            finally:
                selector.close()
            if not line:
                raise RuntimeError("The original operator stopped before startup: " + self.error.read_text(errors="replace")[-10000:])
            self.receipt = json.loads(line)
            if self.receipt["project"]["id"] is None:
                raise ValueError("The original operator omitted its workspace identity")
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def close(self):
        if self.child.poll() is None:
            self.child.terminate()
            try:
                self.child.wait(timeout=120)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                self.child.kill()
                self.child.wait()
        if self.child.stdout:
            self.child.stdout.close()
        self.error_file.close()

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("model_receiving", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", type=Path, help="The same received model workspace at its current path")
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--operator-state", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--scratch", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--source-revision", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--node", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--node-modules", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--chromium", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--upload-limit-mib", type=int, default=4096)
    parser.add_argument("--task-timeout-seconds", type=int, default=14400)
    parser.add_argument("--omit-native-intermediates", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--resume-failed-tasks", action="store_true",
                        help="Continue the retained failed task after its concrete source/input repair")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not 1 <= args.upload_limit_mib <= 65536 or args.task_timeout_seconds <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Select the receiving file capacity and native task observation interval")
    for path in (args.node, args.chromium, args.node_modules / "playwright/index.mjs"):
        if not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Select the actual installed receiving runtime: " + str(path))
    model, workspace, original = checked_model(args.model_receiving, args.workspace)
    output = args.output.resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    scratch = args.scratch.resolve()
    scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    state = (args.operator_state or output / "private/operator-state").resolve()
    received_root = scratch / "received"
    progress = output / "operator-browser-progress.json"
    source_sha = hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()
    result_path = output / "operator-receiving-result.json"
    with held(output / ".operator-receiving.lock", blocking=False):
        original_path = output / "original-native-model-result.json"
        if original_path.exists() and original_path.read_bytes() != original:
            raise ValueError("The retained native-model handoff differs")
        if not original_path.exists():
            atomic(original_path, original, raw=True)
        if result_path.exists():
            accepted = json.loads(result_path.read_text())
            if accepted.get("complete"):
                if (accepted.get("workspace_id") != model["workspace_id"] or
                        accepted.get("original_model_result", {}).get("sha256") != source_sha):
                    raise ValueError("The completed receiving result belongs to another native model handoff")
                for name in ("browser_progress", "delivery_archive", "workspace_archive"):
                    item = accepted[name]
                    if record(item["path"]) != item:
                        raise ValueError("The completed receiving artifact differs: " + name)
                print(json.dumps({"complete": True, "reused": True,
                                  "source_revision": accepted["source_revision"],
                                  "workspace_id": model["workspace_id"], "result": record(result_path),
                                  "workspace_archive": accepted["workspace_archive"],
                                  "delivery_archive": accepted["delivery_archive"]}), flush=True)
                return
        result = {"schema": "upstate.operator-native-receiving/v1", "source_revision": args.source_revision,
                  "original_model_result": record(original_path), "workspace_id": model["workspace_id"],
                  "started_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()), "complete": False,
                  "runtime": {"python": sys.version, "node": str(args.node), "chromium": str(args.chromium)}}
        attempt_dir = output / "attempts" / str(uuid.uuid4())
        attempt_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
        control = output / "private/control.json"
        server = None
        try:
            if progress.exists():
                previous = json.loads(progress.read_text())
                if previous["model_receiving_sha256"] != source_sha:
                    raise ValueError("The browser continuation belongs to another native-model result")
                received = previous.get("received")
                if received and not Path(received["directory"]).exists():
                    from model.portable import restore
                    archive = previous["workspace_archive"]
                    if file_digest(archive["path"]) != archive["sha256"]:
                        raise ValueError("The original receiving archive changed")
                    restored = restore(archive["path"], received["directory"])
                    if restored["project"]["id"] != model["workspace_id"] or restored["archive_sha256"] != archive["sha256"]:
                        raise ValueError("Reconstructed receiving differs from the retained original")
                    result["receiving_reconstructed"] = restored
            server = OperatorProcess(APP, workspace.root, state, received_root, attempt_dir, "original", args.upload_limit_mib)
            def browser(mode, current_server, application):
                receipt = current_server.receipt
                if receipt["project"]["id"] != model["workspace_id"]:
                    raise ValueError("The operator opened another native workspace")
                atomic(control, {"mode": mode, "operator_url": receipt["operator_url"],
                    "workspace_key": receipt["workspace_key"], "model": model,
                    "model_receiving_sha256": source_sha, "source_revision": args.source_revision,
                    "output": str(output), "progress": str(progress), "node_modules": str(args.node_modules.resolve()),
                    "chromium": str(args.chromium.resolve()), "include_intermediates": not args.omit_native_intermediates,
                    "resume_failed_tasks": args.resume_failed_tasks, "task_timeout_seconds": args.task_timeout_seconds})
                run_command([str(args.node), str(application / "operator/receiving.mjs"), str(control)],
                            attempt_dir, mode + "-browser")
            browser("operate", server, APP)
            stage = json.loads(progress.read_text())
            server.close()
            server = None
            receiving = stage["received"]
            application = Path(receiving["application"])
            directory = Path(receiving["workspace"])
            cli = run_command([sys.executable, "-B", str(application / "model/cli.py"),
                               "--workspace", str(directory), "overview"], attempt_dir, "delivered-cli")
            overview = json.loads(cli.read_text())
            if overview["project"]["id"] != model["workspace_id"]:
                raise ValueError("The delivered original CLI opened another workspace")
            for key in model["runs"].values():
                if not any(x["id"] == key and x["state"] == "complete" for x in overview["runs"]):
                    raise ValueError("The delivered CLI lost a completed native result")
            server = OperatorProcess(application, directory, output / "private/received-operator",
                                     scratch / "received-again", attempt_dir, "delivered", args.upload_limit_mib)
            browser("reopened", server, application)
            stage = json.loads(progress.read_text())
            if not stage.get("complete"):
                raise ValueError("The delivered original browser did not finish")
            result.update(complete=True, completed_at=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
                          browser_progress=record(progress), delivery_archive=stage["delivery_archive"],
                          workspace_archive=stage["workspace_archive"], received=receiving,
                          delivered_cli=record(cli), original_run_ids=model["runs"],
                          original_comparison_id=model["comparison_id"])
            atomic(result_path, result)
            print(json.dumps({"complete": True, "workspace_id": model["workspace_id"],
                              "result": record(result_path), "workspace_archive": stage["workspace_archive"],
                              "delivery_archive": stage["delivery_archive"]}), flush=True)
        except BaseException as error:
            result["error"] = {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}
            if progress.exists():
                result["browser_progress"] = record(progress)
            atomic(result_path, result)
            raise
        finally:
            if server is not None:
                server.close()
            control.unlink(missing_ok=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
